title: Mobile Dog Salon & Pet Spa | Northwest Dallas TX

facts.fact: The vendor states that most grooming appointments last between 1 to 2 hours, depending on the size, breed, and condition of the pet's coat.
facts.quote: Most appointments last between 1 to 2 hours, depending on the size, breed, and condition of your pet's coat.

facts.fact: The vendor requires that a pet parent or guardian be home at the beginning of the appointment to greet the groomer and the pet.
facts.quote: Yes, we ask that a pet parent or guardian is home at the beginning of the appointment to greet the groomer and your pet.

facts.fact: The vendor states that its mobile grooming vans are fully self-contained with their own water supply and power system, so customers do not need to provide water or electricity.
facts.quote: Our mobile grooming vans are fully self-contained with their own water supply and power system.

facts.fact: The vendor states that all grooming takes place in a cage-free environment and never uses cages or crate dryers.
facts.quote: Never. All grooming takes place in a quiet, cage-free environment — just one pet, one groomer, and lots of gentle care.

facts.fact: The vendor states that nail trimming, ear cleaning, and teeth cleaning are included with every service.
facts.quote: Nail trimming, ear cleaning, and teeth cleaning Included with every service, ensuring full pet care.

facts.fact: The vendor says it primarily grooms dogs and cats of all breeds, sizes, and ages, including seniors and special-needs pets.
facts.quote: We primarily groom dogs and cats of all breeds, sizes, and ages — including seniors and special-needs pets.

facts.fact: The vendor's listed phone number for the Northwest Dallas location is 469-402-1956.
The vendor offers a Bath & Blowout package that includes a relaxing shampoo and gentle fluff-drying with premium products tailored to the pet's coat, listed without a price on the page.
facts.quote: Relaxing shampoo and gentle fluff-drying with premium products tailored to your pet's coat.
